description: Frames calibration corpus: fixed-clock frame schedules over a bound DesignIR panel and a scripted UI. Fixtures resolve beside this file. Each case stages its schedule; drop_at names the frame a dropped-vsync control delays, chosen inside an animation so the control has something to change.

cases.note: Knob hover glow (frames 2-6 rise, 10-14 fall), host write to cutoff, a second editor attached at 16 and dragged at 18, combo open/highlight/select at 20-22, resize at 24, detach at 26.

View-first (deferred) document load, an animation-frame countdown to 'ready', hover glow from 8, a second editor attached at 10, a drag at 12, a host write at 14, resize of editor 1 at 16, combo select at 17-19, detach at 20.

Timer-driven readiness and animation: a 50 ms setTimeout flips the status label and a 20 ms setInterval counts to five. Under the schedule's host clock both land on the frames whose scheduled time passes their deadlines; the timer-clock-ignored control re-runs it on the wall clock.
